statement: A CVE tied to the Microsoft Defender ShieldBreak privilege-escalation flaw disclosed around 11 Aug 2026 will be added to the CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog with a dateAdded between 2026-08-13 and 2026-09-02.
resolution: TRUE if the CISA KEV catalog lists a CVE matching the ShieldBreak Defender flaw with dateAdded between 2026-08-13 and 2026-09-02, checked 2026-09-04; otherwise FALSE.
failure_condition: No CVE matching the ShieldBreak Defender flaw appears in the CISA KEV catalog with a dateAdded in the stated window as of the deadline.

statement: CISA will publish an advisory or alert naming Sandworm or UAC-0145 in connection with the trojanized WireGuard VPN campaign reported 11-12 Aug 2026, dated between 2026-08-13 and 2026-08-27.
resolution: TRUE if a CISA advisory or alert dated 2026-08-13 through 2026-08-27 names Sandworm or UAC-0145 tied to the WireGuard campaign, checked 2026-08-31; otherwise FALSE.
failure_condition: CISA publishes no advisory or alert naming Sandworm or UAC-0145 for this campaign dated within the stated window as of the deadline.

statement: A Houthi or other Iran-aligned attack will kill at least one person in Red Sea, Gulf of Aden, or Strait of Hormuz shipping-lane activity between 2026-08-13 and 2026-09-02, beyond the fatalities already reported 12 Aug 2026.
resolution: TRUE if two or more wire services report a fatal Houthi or Iran-aligned attack on shipping or shipping-adjacent targets in the Red Sea, Gulf of Aden, or Strait of Hormuz corridor between 2026-08-13 and 2026-09-02, checked 2026-09-04.
failure_condition: No two-source wire report of a fatal Houthi or Iran-aligned attack on shipping-lane targets in that corridor is dated within the stated window.

statement: Russia will board, detain, or seize a European Union-flagged or EU-owned commercial vessel between 2026-08-13 and 2026-09-02, consistent with the tit-for-tat seizure warning reported 12 Aug 2026.
resolution: TRUE if two or more wire services or hostile-side channels confirm Russian authorities boarded, detained, or seized an EU-flagged or EU-owned vessel between 2026-08-13 and 2026-09-02, checked 2026-09-04.
failure_condition: No two-source confirmation of a Russian boarding, detention, or seizure of an EU-flagged or EU-owned vessel dated within the stated window exists at the deadline.

statement: Hakainde Hichilema will be declared winner of Zambia's 13 August 2026 presidential election outright in the first round, with more than 50 percent of valid votes, by 2026-08-21.
resolution: TRUE if the Electoral Commission of Zambia declares Hichilema the first-round winner with over 50 percent of valid votes by 2026-08-21; a runoff or another winner resolves FALSE.
failure_condition: The ECZ calls a runoff, declares a different winner, or has issued no declared presidential result at all by 2026-08-21.

statement: NYMEX WTI front-month crude oil futures will settle at or above 85.00 USD per barrel on 2026-09-04, up from the 83.20 reference level reported 12 Aug 2026.
resolution: TRUE if the NYMEX WTI front-month futures settlement price on 2026-09-04 is 85.00 USD per barrel or higher, per the exchange settlement record; otherwise FALSE.
failure_condition: The NYMEX WTI front-month settlement price on 2026-09-04 closes below 85.00 USD per barrel.

statement: The Federal Open Market Committee will cut its federal funds target range by 25 basis points or more at its 15-16 September 2026 meeting.
resolution: TRUE if the FOMC statement released 2026-09-16 lowers the federal funds target range by 25 basis points or more from the prior 3.50-3.75 percent range; otherwise FALSE.
failure_condition: The FOMC holds the federal funds target range unchanged or raises it in its 2026-09-16 statement.

statement: A magnitude 6.0 or greater aftershock will be recorded by USGS within the epicentral region of the 12 Aug 2026 M7.4 Colombia earthquake between 2026-08-13 and 2026-09-11.
resolution: TRUE if USGS lists a magnitude 6.0-plus event within 200 km of the M7.4 Colombia mainshock, dated between 2026-08-13 and 2026-09-11, checked 2026-09-14; otherwise FALSE.
failure_condition: No USGS-listed magnitude 6.0 or greater event within 200 km of the mainshock falls within the stated window as of the deadline.

statement: The Egyptian student whose kidnapping was livestreamed, per the report dated 12 Aug 2026, will be confirmed located, released, or recovered by two or more sources between 2026-08-13 and 2026-09-02.
resolution: TRUE if two or more news sources confirm the student has been located, released, or recovered, dated between 2026-08-13 and 2026-09-02, checked 2026-09-04; otherwise FALSE.
failure_condition: No two-source confirmation that the student was located, released, or recovered is dated within the stated window as of the deadline.
